entry.title: Polyglot
entry.content:
An English post that mixes in other scripts with language spans, so the right font is selected.

Japanese

The word 日本語 means “Japanese”.

Chinese

中文 means “Chinese”. 繁體 is traditional Chinese.

Korean

한국어 means “Korean”.

Spanish

Español means “Spanish”.
